about: A fictional adult aged 29 has four consecutive Temaze 10 mg supplies (quantity 25 nightly, 100 days total), shown by brand only.
A fictional adult aged 40 has eight consecutive fortnightly Imovane 7.5 mg supplies (quantity 14 nightly, 112 days total) buried in a long history.
A fictional adult aged 34 receives a single short-term 10-day supply of Temaze 10 mg (quantity 10, one at night for 10 nights), cleanly under 8 weeks.
